VERIFIED: Council press release 1125/25 of 19.12.2025. Limits set by the ECB but must respect an overall CEILING AGREED BY THE COUNCIL, reviewed at least every two years. PSPs may not charge consumers for mandatory services (opening and closing accounts, transactions, funding and defunding); added-value services may be charged. Framework guaranteeing access to mobile device producers' hardware and software. Compensation: interchange and merchant service charges capped for a transitional period of at least five years at levels based on comparable means of payment, then cost-based. Banks: mixed (political ceiling favourable, free mandatory services and capped compensation costly). Payment providers: negative (fee caps, then cost-based pricing). Device gatekeepers: negative (mandated access).
